prompt: The same workshop at night. Keep the exact composition, camera, framing, every object and its position, and the same pixel-art style: a strict, even grid, no anti-aliasing, consistent one-art-pixel outlines, hand-placed dithering. A single bare bulb hangs over the workbench and casts a warm amber-orange pool of light; a few tiny orange indicator lights glow on the half-built machines; the grimy window is dark plum with no stars and no moon; the high shelf with the sketchbook and the seedling falls into shadow, still just visible. Palette for the dark theme: deep warm brown-black (#1A1612), dark umber (#241F19), muted taupe (#A8998A), cream highlights (#EFE6D2), and warm orange light (#E8743B). Keep the transparent background around the vignette, with nothing outside it. No people, no animals, no text, no logos, no stars, no moon, no sparkles.
